{{Quote|The course primarily sticks to major waterways around Nashal and therefore is impractical for mount or foot racing. On a hover vehicle, it is considered a delightful afternoon outing.|The [[Nashal River Race]] coordinator, to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:NRT" />}}
The '''Mephyt River''', also known as the '''Krisa River''', was a river located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. The [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nashal]] was built along its banks.<ref name="SWG:NRT" />

[[File:Mephyt_River.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Mephyt River, running through [[Nashal]]]]

Notable portions of the river included [[The Narrows (Talus)|the Narrows]], the [[Virrago Bend]], [[Garva's Turn]], the [[Quid Embankment]] and the [[Fed-Dub Stretch]]. This waterway met with other rivers at [[Xahn's Crossing]] and at the [[Deep Run]] confluences. The Krisa River was used as a racetrack for the [[Nashal River Race]].<ref name="SWG:NRT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mephyt River first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Its name was revealed in the description of the [[City/Legends|city]] of Nashal that was shown to players on the screen that allowed them to choose the starting location for a new character.<ref name="SWG:N">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Starting Location: "Nashal"</ref> These description texts were removed when [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] was made the starting city for all players with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]" on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> However, in the same game, the river in Nashal was identified as the Krisa River during the Nashal River Race.<ref name="SWG:NRT" />
